review.missing: We could not find this review. Start with a fresh action.

route.heading: Route details
route.unsupported: This vault is not supported yet. Choose a supported vault to continue.
route.changed: This route has changed since it was reviewed. It needs another check before use.
fee.changed: The fee is higher than your limit. Review the new maximum before signing.
pending.heading: Waiting for the network
pending.body: Your action has been submitted. We are checking its result.

pending.leave: You can leave this page. Your transaction hash will be here when you return.

success.heading: Your action is complete

failure.shares: There are not enough shares for this action. Check your balance and choose a new amount.
failure.authority: The wallet authorization did not match this action. Start with a fresh review.
failure.generic: The network could not complete this action. Its confirmed details are available below.

activity.empty: Nothing here yet. A perfectly respectable start.
receipt.heading: Your receipt
receipt.unresolved: This transaction result has not been confirmed by the available provider.
details.copy_failed: Copying did not work. You can select the value and copy it yourself.

input.positive: Choose an amount greater than zero.
input.too_large: That amount is too large for this action.

service.offline: You appear to be offline. Reconnect to check this action.
service.busy: The network check is busy. Give it a moment, then try again.

demo.note: These are example assets. No real transaction can be signed here.
